items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I did the jazz at noon about three years ago for Les Leiber.

ctx.x: come back into New York, though you're still living in Charlottesville, still based there, you've come back up now three times. When was the last time you had a date in New York before this one in September of '79?
Well, I did the jazz at noon about three years ago for Les Leiber.
That's while you were living in Charlottesville, that you came up?
